title: NR UE Power Class — reference for test engineers
spec_refs: TS 38.101-2 Table 6.2.1.0-1 (FR2 UE types / power class)
summary: NR categorizes UE maximum output power into power classes (FR1: up to ~31 dBm; FR2: TRP/EIRP limits per class). Class 3 (23 dBm) is the default FR1 smartphone class. Power class affects link budget, cell edge UL throughput, and interference.

classes.label: Power Class 1
classes.use_case: Fixed wireless, vehicle-mounted, public safety — highest FR1 UE power
classes.bands_note: Band-specific; not all bands support PC1

classes.label: Power Class 1.5
classes.use_case: Smartphones and FWA on n77/n78 (HPUE mid-tier)

classes.label: Power Class 2
classes.use_case: NR TDD intra-band CA, HPUE (High Power UE)

classes.label: Power Class 3
classes.use_case: Default smartphone class unless otherwise specified
classes.bands_note: Supported on all FR1 bands by default

classes.label: Power Class 7
classes.use_case: RedCap (Reduced Capability) UE — lowest power FR2 class

ue_capability_ie: ue-PowerClass (ENUMERATED pc1, pc2, pc3, … in UECapabilityInformation per band)
test_checks: Confirm UE declares correct ue-PowerClass in UECapabilityInformation for band under test
FR1 HPUE (PC2/PC1.5): verify max UL power and duty cycle on n77/n78 lab plan
FR2: validate TRP/EIRP and spherical coverage per class (38.101-2 §6.2.1)
Cell edge UL: compare PC3 (23 dBm) vs HPUE — expect ~3–8 dB link budget difference
RedCap devices: expect Power Class 7 constraints on FR2

troubleshooting.symptom: Poor UL throughput at cell edge despite good DL
checks: UE power class — PC3 phone vs HPUE DUT?
Verify configured max UL power not capped by network (p-Max, TPC)
Check band supports declared power class in 38.101-1 Table 6.2.1-1

troubleshooting.symptom: mmWave OTA fail on EIRP/spherical coverage
checks: Match FR2 power class (PC3 handheld vs PC1 FWA)
Review 85%/60%/50%-tile CDF spherical coverage tables for class
Multi-band relaxation factors (ΔMBPn, ΔMBSn) if DUT supports multiple FR2 bands

troubleshooting.symptom: HPUE feature not active on n78
checks: UE capa must declare PC2 or PC1.5 for band
Network must allow HPUE power class for that band
Amarisoft/UE profile power class setting matches DUT capability
